This app keeps getting worse and worse. Update: Truly sad that TTB has caved to the growing anti-privacy and insecure practices that social media is promoting. I have supported this ministry for years, but that is unfortunately ending until common sense returns to the board. 

How can anyone view the privacy policy if they have no way to view it? Clicking on anything other than the donate link on the website just returns you to the app store. Seems greed has finally captured the hearts of this ministry. Truly sad and I am sure McGee would not approve at all?!
😞

Update: First off I need to state that the poor review does not reflect my view of the organization as a whole... I have listened and supported this ministry off and on since the early 80s, and very much enjoy McGee's content. With that said, the app is still broken. Content does not load, and the business decisions being made have forced me back to listening to the radio... I am a bit more knowledgable than the average user, having worked in IT since before the Internet was public and currently supporting literally 100s of online companies, it is obvious to me that TTB has been influenced by the deceptive marketing and analytics side of the Internet. Understand while you may not think you are collecting personal information, the use of beacons to record access, requiring a login, along with a record of an IP is enough to positively identify anyone. And how you store that information is important, because when you get hacked (not if, but when... it is happening every minute in the fortune 500 space, how much are you spending on security?) the information you store will become public almost immediately. Most people do not even understand the cell carriers and ISPs are selling their data both as aggregate, and individually for marketing purposes. All you need is a single line from an DNS log accessing a web beacon to associate a name with a domain. 

 I might provide a positive review if you remove the account requirement to access content. The app appeared to break when that was implemented, and along with the new extensions for webkit to block beacons and anonymize connections in iOS 15+, this has the app unusable with any kind of online security enabled. I do thank TTB for the reply finally, but unfortunately, nothing has changed for this user. :( --- The content does not seem to load on iPhone SE running iOS 15.6. The Daily card at the top of the page never loads. The Question and Answers and Sunday Sermon cards load, but when clicked it reads 0 of 0 complete with no content loaded in the list. This was happening intermittent before, but now it is happening everytime the app runs. I have tried deleting the app and reinstalling on two identical phones and it does not resolve the issue. I hope the developers can figure it out. 

UPDATE: It seems to be related to the developers allowing the mining of personal info by requiring an account. This really saddens me. Such a great app before all the analytics and privacy violations were added. I guess it is back to recording it off the radio. The ethics of this app is not Christian... I hope TTB will educate themselves regarding technology, and not cave to the worlds deceptive online practices.
